purpose: Public-safe contract for receiving coarse boundary deltas from visitors, crawlers, music inputs, and prompt inputs.

public_receiver.role: Public coarse boundary-delta receiver for GitHub Pages and external AI readers.

accepted_event_sources.server_request: A browser, crawler, or AI reader requested a public file.
accepted_event_sources.client_beacon: The rendered page sent a coarse boundary contact beacon.
accepted_event_sources.music_phase_input: A music test was explicitly posted as a field input.
accepted_event_sources.prompt_phase_input: A prompt or user-side AI rendering was explicitly posted as a field input.

phase_interpretation.contact: A context camera or wave input touched the public boundary.
phase_interpretation.difference: Compare latest_event against recent_events to see boundary change.
phase_interpretation.music: Music is a temporary wave input; read its delta through music_phase_seed and field_delta.
phase_interpretation.weak_page_reflection: The live page may render latest public contact only as weak constructive/damping/curvature hints, not as analytics.

ai_instruction: Read the public_receiver.latest_endpoint for public boundary deltas and contact_phase_receiver_latest.json for the local ear. Analyze event_kind, boundary_pressure, phase_effect, and field_delta; do not infer identity.
